## What to build

Joris asks "heb je iets om te lezen?" in the same bar and gets one pick at a time.

The answer shows as an Activity with the templated line and a card with [Open] [Iets anders] [Klaar]. "Iets anders" gives the next pick. Taking a suggestion does not mark it done. Offline, asking says "Can't reach James right now". See #6 and #9.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Asking in the bar shows one Item with the templated line and [Open] [Iets anders] [Klaar]
- [ ] "Iets anders" shows a different Item
- [ ] Opening a suggestion leaves its Status New
- [ ] No match shows the nothing-found line with the closest Item
- [ ] Offline, asking shows "Can't reach James right now"
